claims.statement: Management targets an annual store base increase of approximately 15%.
claims.quote: internally, our benchmarks will remain that we should be opening around 15% of our store base as the number that we want to increase annually.

claims.statement: Avenue Supermarts aims to deliver to most online customers within six hours of ordering.
claims.quote: We want to make sure that we are able to deliver to most of our customers within six hours of their ordering.

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts reached the 500-store milestone and entered five new states last year.
facts.quote: last year, we entered five new states, and we also hit the 500-store milestone.

facts.statement: As of March 2026, the company had 20.6 million square feet of retail business area.
facts.quote: At the end of March 2026, we had about 20.6 million square feet of retail business area

facts.statement: Total debt as of March 2026 end was INR2,267 crores, while net borrowing was close to INR965 crores.
facts.quote: Total Debt inched up slightly to INR2,267 crores. This INR2,267 crores also includes debt arising out of AS 116 adjustment. The actual debt, which is net borrowing on the company, is close to INR965 crores as of March 2026 end.

facts.statement: Cash generated from operations for the year was INR4,168 crores.
facts.quote: and we generated INR4,168 crores of cash from the operations.
